stories.title: Create verification/ directory structure, Project.toml, CondaPkg.toml, .gitignore
stories.description:
## Mission

## Steps

1. Create directories:

   - BasisSimulator source: `path = "../"`
   - Keep all [compat] entries
   - Change name to "BasisSimulatorVerification" (same as before)

3. Create `verification/CondaPkg.toml`:
   - Copy from source (numpy + gecatsim pip dep)

4. Create `verification/.gitignore`:
   ```
   .CondaPkg/
   Manifest.toml
   .DS_Store
   figures/
   catsim_work/
   *.air
   *.offset
   *.scan
   ```

5. Update `BasisSimulator.jl/.gitignore` to add:
   ```
   # Verification environment
   verification/.CondaPkg/
   verification/Manifest.toml
   verification/figures/
   verification/catsim_work/
   ```

6. Checkpoint: commit scaffold

## Verify

- All directories exist
- Project.toml parses correctly
- .gitignore is correct

stories.title: Set up XCAT phantom data with Git LFS tracking + download instructions
stories.description:
## Mission

Set up XCAT phantom data. The binary is 1 GB so needs Git LFS or a download script.

## Steps

1. Check if Git LFS is initialized in the repo:
   ```bash
   git lfs install  # If not already
   git lfs track 'verification/data/xcat/*.bin'
   ```

2. Copy XCAT files:
   - vmale_50_1600x1400x500_8bit_little_endian_act_1.bin → verification/data/xcat/
   - Material_Spreadsheets/*.xlsx → verification/data/xcat/Material_Spreadsheets/

3. Update .gitattributes for LFS tracking:
   ```
   verification/data/xcat/*.bin filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
   ```

4. If LFS is not viable, create a download script instead:
   - verification/data/xcat/download_xcat.sh
   - Document where the data lives
   - Add .bin to .gitignore

5. Checkpoint: commit

## Decision Point

If git lfs is available and the hosting supports it, use LFS.
If not, use .gitignore + download script + README explaining where to get the data.
The XLSX files (26 KB total) should always be committed directly.
acceptance_criteria: XCAT binary either in LFS or documented download procedure

## Mission

## Steps

1. Check if the source binary exists:


   ```bash
   ln -sf /Users/daleblack/Documents/dev/CTSimulatorStuff/BasisSimulatorVerification/notebooks/phantom_export_xcat/vmale_50_1600x1400x500_8bit_little_endian_act_1.bin verification/data/xcat/vmale_50_1600x1400x500_8bit_little_endian_act_1.bin
   ```

stories.title: Add CM.save() calls to NB05's 6 figures
stories.description:
## Mission

NB05 (05_xcat_full.jl) creates 6 inline Pluto figures but never calls CM.save(). Add CM.save() calls so figures are written to verification/figures/.

## Figures to Save

Search the notebook for figure creation patterns (CM.Figure, etc.) and add CM.save() after each:

1. `nb05_scanner_comparison.png` — Scanner comparison (Section 8.1)
2. `nb05_fdk_vs_hir.png` — FDK vs HIR comparison (Section 8.2)
3. `nb05_detail_comparison.png` — Detail comparison (Section 8.3)
4. `nb05_vmi_comparison.png` — VMI comparison (Section 8.4)
5. `nb05_noise_stats.png` — Noise statistics (Section 8.5)
6. `nb05_noise_reduction.png` — Noise reduction (Section 8.6)

## Rules

- Preserve Pluto cell IDs (do NOT modify UUIDs)
- Use the same pattern as NB01-04: `CM.save(joinpath(FIGURES_DIR, "nb05_xxx.png"), fig)`
- Add the save call AFTER the figure is fully constructed (after the last axis/legend call)
- The notebook already defines FIGURES_DIR

## Verify

- Search for all CM.Figure or figure creation patterns
- Confirm 6 save calls added
- No cell IDs modified
- CHECKPOINT
